shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup Switch useTheme
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup useTheme useThemeType; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; grep -n -i -C 3 'theme' $U/README.md | head -80; grep -n -i -C 4 'switch\|system\|useTheme\|localStorage' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -80; cat $U/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n -A 14 'interface ControlGroupProps' $U/types.d.ts; grep -n 'Flex\|Text\b\|Card\|useThemeValue\|useTheme\b\|SegmentedRadioGroup' $U/index.d.ts $U/theme/index.d.ts; grep -n 'gap\|direction\|alignItems' $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n "variant" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3

grep -rn "header-1\|subheader-1\|body-1\|'secondary'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules | grep -i jsdom

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n\nimport { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { AppThemeProvider } from './AppThemeProvider';")
s=s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme="light">','<AppThemeProvider>').replace('</ThemeProvider>','</AppThemeProvider>')
s=s.replace("// Preconfigured Gravity UI setup is ALREADY wired here (both CSS imports + ThemeProvider).\n// Implement the requested feature in App.tsx (you may add sibling files).\n","// AppThemeProvider wraps uikit's ThemeProvider and persists the chosen theme in localStorage.\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat src/main.tsx; grep -n "secondary" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -2
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15 && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -12
